name: Two-Wing Bound from the Relative Corner Threshold
statement: If $H$ has minimum cardinality among nonempty cornerless ample families, then $|H|\ge 2\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}+2$. Consequently, the bound $\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}\ge22$ would exclude every cornerless ample family of order below $46$.
proof: For any active coordinate, let $A_0,A_1$ be the two projected sections and $B=A_0\cap A_1$. Minimality puts all three smaller ample families in $\mathsf{Damp}$, and the pc-minimal obstruction property makes the coordinate nonperipheral. Hence each wing $D_b=A_b\setminus B$ is nonempty. A corner of $A_b$ outside $B$ would lift to a corner of $H$, so every corner of either section lies in $B$. Both pairs $B\subsetneq A_b$ therefore contribute to the defining minimum, giving $|D_b|\ge\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}$; since $B$ is nonempty, $|H|=|D_0|+|D_1|+2|B|\ge2\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}+2$.
